outcome: Admission to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Pregnant Omani women who delivered at the Sultan Qaboos University Hospital in Muscat, Oman, between January 2009 and December 2010
finding: Women with PGDM were at higher risk of developing obstetric and perinatal complications such as pre-eclampsia, preterm delivery, and Caesarean delivery compared to women with GDM.
